title: Auth Focus Reset
summary: YTIntel is now locking onto one core experience at a time. First target: one reliable account session and a core Analyse flow that never gets blocked by a false sign-in state.
discord_changes: One shared YTIntel auth session now powers account, cloud and plan layers instead of competing Supabase clients.
Analyse automatically recovers from false Sign in required states and stays usable without an account.
Feature expansion is paused while the Sign in → Analyse core loop is perfected first.
changes: Added a canonical auth core that loads before the cloud, account and commercial layers and forces them to reuse one Supabase client/session.
Added session refresh and a single ytintel:auth state event so signed-in UI and backend actions stop disagreeing about whether the user is authenticated.
Added an Analyse recovery path that retries the original public analyser directly if another layer incorrectly injects a Sign in required error.
Added signed-in retry recovery for account-backed actions when a stale token causes a false authentication failure.
Kept core Analyse public: account sign-in remains optional for the primary evidence workflow.
Bumped the PWA shell to v0.29.1 and added deployment syntax validation for the new auth core.
Development focus is now intentionally frozen on Sign in + Analyse before another feature receives priority.
why_it_matters: A product with ten features is not useful if the first action feels unreliable. This release makes authentication one system instead of several competing systems and formally shifts YTIntel to one-core-loop-at-a-time development.
